shellCommands.command: ls -la && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat package.json && echo "---TREE---" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50
for f in pages/_app.tsx pages/_document.tsx pages/index.tsx pages/about.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && ls 01-app && echo "--- grep migration ---" && find . -iname "*migrat*"

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && ls 01-getting-started && echo "--- api-reference/file-conventions ---" && ls 03-api-reference/ && ls 03-api-reference/*file-conventions* 2>/dev/null
sed -n '/## Migrating from `pages` to `app`/,/### Step 5/p' app-router-migration.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions && ls | head -40 && echo "=== generate-viewport ===" && sed -n '1,120p' generate-viewport.md 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components && ls && echo "=== link version history + notes ===" && grep -n -B3 -A 25 "## Version History" link.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components && wc -l link.md && sed -n '1,90p' link.md && echo "...HEADINGS..." && grep -n "^#\{2,4\} " link.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions && sed -n '1,60p' page.md && echo "=== props helper ===" && grep -n -A 20 "Page Props Helper" page.md | head -40
cd /workspace && git rm -r --quiet pages 2>/dev/null || rm -rf pages; ls -a; echo "--- pages gone? ---"; ls pages 2>&1 | head -2

(npm run start > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; curl -sf http://localhost:3000/ -o /dev/null && break; done; echo "=== / ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE '[^<]*|]*>|]*>|

[^<]*

|]*>[^<]*'; echo "=== /about ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/about | grep -oE '[^<]*|]*>|

[^<]*

|]*>[^<]*'; echo "=== /contact (expect 404) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/contact
pkill -f "next-server\|next start" ; sleep 1; git status --short; echo "--- tsconfig include ---"; grep -n "include" tsconfig.json; echo "--- untracked new files ---"; find app -type f
